stated: Introduce a ‘Tutoring Guarantee’ for every disadvantaged pupil who needs extra support.

source.quote: Introduce a ‘Tutoring Guarantee’ for every disadvantaged pupil who needs extra support.

bearing_set.reason: Directly targets educational attainment support for disadvantaged pupils, bearing materially on the attainment gap and opportunity for lower-income children.
By design concentrates support on disadvantaged pupils, narrowing the educational attainment gap between richer and poorer children, a primary driver of income and opportunity inequality.

A universal guarantee for every eligible disadvantaged pupil (c.1.9m in England) represents a material ongoing spending commitment; without a stated funding offset it risks widening the funded/borrowed gap.

membership_note: Policy bears on three fundamentals: its designed-for education-attainment benefit (O7), a genuine distributional-gap-narrowing effect (O14), and a real public-finance cost dimension given the scale of a 'guarantee' for all disadvantaged pupils (O12).
